correctness.rationale: For stationary run/turn switching alpha,beta, and angular first harmonic cosine c, the exact backward first-harmonic evolution is u_r,u_t derivative=[[-(alpha+d_r),alpha],[beta*c,-(beta+d_t)]](u_r,u_t), initial (1,0). Its characteristic discriminant Delta=(a-b)^2+4alpha beta c yields exactly cosh/sinh if Delta>0, affine-in-time repeated root if Delta=0, or sinusoidal if Delta<0. When c>=0, positivity of Metzler semigroup prevents roots; for c<0 and real roots the sign of a-b decides zero/one, with all endpoints included. Imaginary discriminant has infinitely many simple roots spaced 2pi/sqrt(-Delta). For exact pi reversal and zero angular diffusion, roots of h^2-6h+1 yield 3±2sqrt2. The regular Green–Kubo identity has m2"(t)=2C(t), t>0; independent translational diffusion contributes only linear term. Independently compared direct matrix exponentials with analytic solutions in five parameter configurations including the exceptional root.

originality.rationale: Datta–Beta–Grossmann previously gave a more general renewal velocity autocorrelation transform, and Grossmann–Peruani–Baer already exhibit oscillations in a different reversing model. The specific complete no/one/infinitely-many zeros classification for exponential run/turn waiting times, including repeated-root boundaries and rate thresholds, was not stated in the inspected full transform. Specialization is acknowledged; no novelty claim for the transform or oscillations as such.
